//: Strict compiler options for the PolyCodeBench TypeScript profile (Prompt 19). Used by a task whose hidden quality plan sets typing_expectation: required. `strict` is true here and only here; the base config keeps it off so a task that has not asked for typing is not judged on strictness it never claimed. Each extra option below is one a TypeScript candidate can silently rely on being off: `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` makes `arr[0]` possibly-undefined, `exactOptionalPropertyTypes` makes `{a: undefined}` different from `{}`, `noImplicitOverride` requires `override` on a member that replaces a base member, `useUnknownInCatchVariables` makes a caught value `unknown` instead of `any`, and `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch` stops a case from silently running into the next one. Every one of those defaults to off, so each one has to be asked for here.
